0022600098.text: The Heat have not yet played a 2026-27 game, while the Pistons are 1-0 with a home win, sitting 1st in the Central and 1st in the East. Detroit's Taurean Prince is day-to-day for personal reasons and is a game-time decision. Miami won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 121-110 victory in Miami on March 8, 2026.
